sources.source_name: Yahoo Finance historical adjusted close, public 2016 CSV snapshot
sources.transformation: Legacy Yahoo daily Adj Close through April 28, 2016; take last trading observation of each requested month, ratio adjacent adjusted prices minus one. Splits and cash dividends use Yahoo adjustments, with reinvestment approximation and six-decimal rounding. Provider chain is documented by Scripts/historical.py at the same pinned revision (Yahoo ichart table.csv plus Symbol column). No ticker change, merger, or spin-off mapping in this scenario. Not a contemporaneous database vintage. Raw payload excluded from redistribution.
